name: Wrecking Yard
tagline: One ball. A yard full of trouble.
description: A portrait Unity WebGL arcade game: drag to aim the wrecking ball, release to swing, and work your way through the yard. Real 3D rendering straight from the Unity player rather than a 2D stand-in, a 9:16 play area that scales to fit any screen, and mouse and touch controls. Nothing to install - the payload streams in behind a progress bar and the game runs entirely in the browser.
highlights: Native Unity WebGL build - real 3D rendering, not a 2D stand-in
Drag to aim, release to swing: one ball, one yard at a time
Portrait 9:16 play area, scaled to fit phones, tablets and desktops
Mouse and touch input, no install and no download
Served from GitHub Pages, with the payload checked at deploy time
howToPlay: Open the game and wait for the Unity progress bar - the first load streams about 56 MB
Drag anywhere to aim the ball, then release to swing
Play continues the current yard; Levels lets you pick another
Use the fullscreen button in the footer for the whole 9:16 view
